lines.label: sign-in
lines.said: Renting three items on one order. [[slnc 300]] Enter your email to sign in.

lines.label: new-order
lines.said: Your order opens empty, so add yourself to it first.

lines.label: item-catalogue
lines.said: Open a collection to see what is inside it. [[slnc 300]] Each collection holds gear of one kind, so you can compare before you choose. [[slnc 300]] Start with the board.

lines.label: first-dates
lines.said: Pick the pickup day, then the return day. [[slnc 300]] We hold it for every day between.

lines.label: second-catalogue
lines.said: Go back to the catalogue for the second item, a ski package this time.

lines.label: second-dates
lines.said: Each item gets its own dates, so you can take one out for longer than another.

lines.label: second-item-added
lines.said: That is two on the order.

lines.label: third-catalogue
lines.said: Once more for the third item. [[slnc 300]] There is no limit here — keep adding while the order is still open, and the running total follows along.

lines.label: third-dates
lines.said: Dates for the third item, the same way as the others.

lines.label: the-questions
lines.said: Now the questions. [[slnc 300]] Your height, your boot size, your skill level, your weight and your age. [[slnc 300]] You answer these once, and they apply across every item on the order, so three items is no more work than one. [[slnc 300]] Then agree to the terms and save.

lines.label: checkout
lines.said: One payment covers all three items.

lines.label: back-to-dashboard
lines.said: All three rentals sit together in your order history.
